title: Telemetry event envelope (cartografo v1)
description: The fields present in every event of the log. The log is append-only: the only operation on it is inserting a new row.

id.description: Monotonic, assigned by the server. It is the order of the log and the only total ordering that exists (two events can share the same occurred_at).

type.description: The event discriminator, e.g. "job.created". Every value has a schema of its own that pins this field with const.

project_id.description: The project that owns the event.

execution_id.description: The execution the event belongs to, or null when the event happens outside a round (e.g. registering a graph version).

entity.description: The subject of the event — the key that joins the telemetry to the rest of the database.

id.description: The id of the entity named in entity.type itself. An integer for job/session/input_request/lease/execution — for an execution it is the execution_id itself; a string for graph_version, whose id is the hash of the snapshot (D15).

actor.description: Who caused the event. Parity with flowpilot's ActorType (user/agent/system).

ref.description: A free identification of the actor: the user's login, the agent's role, the name of the system component.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO 8601. It is the only time stamp of the log — a modification column in an append-only log would be a lie.

data.description: The type-specific payload, declared by the type's own schema.
